notes.title: A Thank You with Great News
notes.content:
Great News
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37363299/16c11d64f9889b58ba6ac2eb71611834a74df0c1.gif

We have permanently decreased the price of Virtually Real Life and The Core Message to say thanks to fans and community who supported us. We are already working on something much bigger and something very unique. Once we are ready, more information will be made available.
